usedFor: Todoist holds tasks and Supabase holds the table, so “New Task Created in Project” runs “Add A Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Add A Row To Table” in Supabase
bestTemplate.why: Each task in the chosen project is mirrored as a row, so you can query tasks like any other data.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so the Supabase row appears after a scheduled check.
